question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

_________ are words which have the same spelling or pronunciation but not the same meaning.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Homonyms**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Homonyms **are words that have the same spelling or pronunciation but different meanings.

 
 
• **Example**: "bat" can mean a flying mammal or a piece of sports equipment.
